description: Per-task source-backed CSS (Alford-Han-Prakash parameterized high-density branch) segment parameters for the EOS-06 native crust+core+CSS join. Each entry is a source-backed parameterization of the CSS segment (p_transition, epsilon_low, nb_low, delta_epsilon, cs2) that the native join_crust_core_css (fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_css_join.f90) appends to a matched crust+core table. The parameters are drawn from the Alford-Han-Prakash 2013 reference and the benchmark core's transition-state thermodynamics (the matched crust+core top knot at the join density).

reference.citation: M. G. Alford, S. Han, M. Prakash, Phys. Rev. D 88, 083013 (2013)
reference.role: CSS parameterized high-density branch (constant-sound-speed extension with a first-order Delta_epsilon jump at the transition)
reference.method_note: The CSS segment is the constant-sound-speed (CSS) high-density phase with an optional first-order jump Delta_epsilon at the transition from the hadronic core. The transition jump identity Delta_epsilon = mu_t * Delta_n_B is enforced by the kernel (compose_eos_css.f90 initialize_css_segment). The high phase is epsilon(P) = epsilon_high + (P-P_t)/cs2, nb(P) = nb_high * factor^(1/(1+cs2)), mu_B = (epsilon+P)/nb.

benchmark_conformal_first_order.description: Benchmark conformal CSS segment (cs2 = 1/3) with a first-order jump Delta_epsilon = 0.5*epsilon_low at the matched crust+core (GPPVA_FSU2H crust + GM_GM1 core) top knot. Used by the EOS-06 verification tests as the canonical source-backed parameter set. The transition state (p_transition, epsilon_low, nb_low) is the matched table's top knot thermodynamics, so the CSS high-density branch continues past the core's max density; the jump is a source-backed 0.5*epsilon_low (Alford-Han-Prakash convention for a strong first-order deconfinement transition).
benchmark_conformal_first_order.jump_identity_note: Delta_epsilon = mu_t * Delta_n_B is enforced by compose_eos_css.f90 initialize_css_segment (residual < 64*eps*scale). On this benchmark the verified first-law jump residual is ~4.88e-16 (machine precision).
benchmark_conformal_first_order.causal_note: cs2 = 1/3 is subluminal by construction; the joined finite-difference cs2 ranges from ~3.8e-5 (low-density crust) to ~0.756 (CSS branch) -- all within (0, 1].

blocked_segments.note: Per EOS-03 PASS_OR_BLOCKED_SCOPED, the 6 source-blocked core models (GPPVA_FSU2/FSU2H/NL3wrL55/TM1e Walecca-blocked and SPG_M3/M5 posterior-extreme) do not have source-backed CSS transition parameters in this manifest because their core top-knot thermodynamics are unphysical on the native solver path (oversaturation / isovector-fit limit). A CSS join onto an unphysical core is not source-backed; these remain out of scope for EOS-06 until EOS-03's blocks are lifted (Lalazissis 1997 PDF for Walecca; posterior-fit-J acceptance for SPG_M3/M5).

verification.kernel_test: fortran_eos/tests/test_css_segment.f90 (M5A CI-pass: mu_transition~941, epsilon_high~1881, nb_high~2, constant cs2=0.25 to 1e-12, first-law to 2e-4, rejects acausal cs2=1.01 and negative Delta_epsilon)
verification.join_test: python_frontend/tests/test_eos06_css_branch_join.py (EOS-06: all 6 acceptance criteria on the joined crust+core+CSS table)
